Police Quest

   in Pursuit of the
      Death Angel

      by Jim Walls

  Ver 2.0G     12/3/87
column2:
警察故事

追捕死亡天使

Jim Walls 編劇

版本 2.0G　1987 年 12 月 3 日

column1: POLICE QUEST 2: THE VENGEANCE is the story of Sonny Bonds's race to track down a cold-blooded cop killer before Sonny himself ends up as the next victim. This time, you'll use authentic homicide investigation techniques, master weapons, disarm explosive devices, and more in your desperate efforts to prevent your own murder.
column2: 《警察故事 2：復仇》描述 Sonny Bonds 追查冷血殺警兇手的故事；在自己成為下一名受害者前，你必須運用真正的命案調查技術、熟悉武器、拆除爆裂物，拼命阻止自己的死亡。

column1: POLICE QUEST 3: THE KINDRED thrusts Sonny into a dark world of cult killers, drugs, and a corruption that's spreading throughout the Lytton Police Department itself! PQ3 features a soundtrack by Jan Hammer of MIAMI VICE fame, and our intuitive point-and-click interface.
column2: 《警察故事 3：血親》把 Sonny 推入邪教殺手、毒品，以及蔓延整個 Lytton 警察局的腐敗黑暗世界！《警察故事 3》採用《邁阿密風雲》作曲家 Jan Hammer 的配樂，並提供直覺的點擊介面。
